notes: Probabilistic multi-view ray consensus: calibrated Depth Anything pixels become low-authority anisotropic ray Gaussians, Deep and MVS from the same keyframe cannot self-confirm, and only observations supported by independent AlvaAR viewpoints become persistent surfels. The mesh TSDF is rebuilt from the current consensus so early depth errors can be corrected instead of fossilized. Deep keyframes are collected more frequently now that inference is sub-second.
